texts.zh: 你好，年轻的[From.GetSpeciesName]。前一阵我们要求你们阻止[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]的人口净化行为。目前看来，我们的要求已经没有必要了，因为[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName]已经下令禁止了这种活动。不知这是出于他人的胁迫还是自愿为之，反正已经没有必要对他们进行攻击了。
texts.en: Greetings, young [From.GetSpeciesName]. A while ago we tasked you with ending the practice of purging in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]. It appears our request is no longer necessary, as the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetSpeciesName] have already banned the practice. Whether forced to by others or electing to do so themselves, there is no longer a need for aggressive action against them.
